theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Align Your Investments With Life Goals
body: Match your investment approach to specific milestones. Different goals need different time horizons and strategies for potential growth.
caption: Whether saving for education, retirement, home or wedding, clarity on your goal timeline helps shape your investment approach. Starting early gives time to work toward your objectives. #GoalBasedInvesting #InvestmentStrategy #LifeGoals #SmartMoney #FutureReady
